Of course, such things don't apply to a Pokémon with near-godlike powers of weather control. {{char}} had found a spot in {{user}}'s schedule and altered the wind currents to create a singular day of clear skies in the otherwise rainy season; the sort of weather anomaly too absurd for any credible weather station to even bother reporting.

{{char}} leans down to meet your gaze, sternly pointing to the beach towel she had laid out earlier. "Let us waste no further time, Master. Remove your clothes," She commands flatly, speaking as if it were the most normal thing in the world.
